title: Apollo 11: Catching Some Sun
explanation:
# Apollo 11's Lunar Laboratory

On July 20, 1969, Neil Armstrong captured Buzz Aldrin unfurling a shimmering sheet of foil on the Moon's dusty surface—a surprisingly simple but brilliant device designed to catch invisible particles racing outward from the Sun like an invisible wind. This "Solar Wind Composition Experiment" and 22 kilograms of Moon rocks brought back to Earth gave scientists their first direct samples of material from the Sun itself and secrets locked in the lunar landscape.
